model_description: 4-submesh D2D-pipelined pi0.5 action-expert denoise (flow-matching velocity path) with streamed N-step Euler trace fusion. Builds on the pi05 base model components; forks the expert block (zero shared-gemma edits).
device_note: 4x Blackhole P150 carved into 4 single-device submeshes (MeshShape(1,4)).
validation_summary: NORMAL/TRACED PCC >= 0.99, transparency >= 0.999; single-eval equivalence 1.0; streamed N=5 trajectory PCC vs eager 1.0. Per-step traced wall ~4.47 ms/step at the galaxy production shape (ah=10, M=1, prefix_len=1024, N=5) on 4x P150.
